title: N68: Overnight gap >1.5% → 10.5% VaR violation rate (10x normal), 36% of all violations on 5% of days
description: Analyzed overnight gap (Open[t]/Close[t-1]-1) for SPY 2018-2025. Gap<-1.5%: avg return -2.64%, 88% negative. |Gap|>1.5% days: 5% of days but 36% of VaR violations (10.5% violation rate vs 1.0% normal = 10.5x enrichment). This is a complementary real-time signal to VIX/GARCH ratio — the gap reflects overnight information that GARCH hasn't processed yet.
